overview: This enum says which adaptation category a hit counts toward.

None.simple: This hit does not count toward adaptation.
None.technical: uint8 value 0 and the Damage row constructor default. IsDamageAdaptApplied returns false because the switch has no matching Adapt buff check. CN_240 excludes it from the per-attacker adaptation tally. 748 exported Damage rows use it.

CursedEnergyAttack_1.simple: This hit counts toward the first cursed-energy adaptation.
CursedEnergyAttack_1.technical: uint8 value 1. The generic and CP_020 gates check Adapt_CursedEnergyAttack_1 stacks. CP_230 adds a CP_230_CursedEnergyAttack1 gate. CN_240 zeroes matching damage when the attacker holds the stack and tallies positive damage in the matching field. 225 exported rows use it.

CursedEnergyAttack_2.simple: This hit counts toward the second cursed-energy adaptation.
CursedEnergyAttack_2.technical: uint8 value 2. The generic and CP_020 gates check Adapt_CursedEnergyAttack_2 stacks. CP_110 refuses the gate when CP_110_CursedEnergyAttack2 is absent. CN_240 zeroes matching damage when the attacker holds the stack and tallies positive damage in the matching field. 217 exported rows use it.

ExtraAttack.simple: This hit counts toward extra-attack adaptation.
ExtraAttack.technical: uint8 value 3. The generic and CP_020 gates check Adapt_ExtraAttack stacks. CN_240 zeroes matching damage when the attacker holds the stack and tallies positive damage in the matching field. Eleven exported rows use it.

Invalid.technical: uint8 value 255. CN_240 explicitly excludes it from the adaptation tally. No exported row uses it and no other branch names it.

notes: RequestFlag64 equal to 1 disables the generic adapt gate before the switch runs.
CN_240 adds to a per-attacker FCN_240_AdaptDamage tally only when the hit damage is positive and the type is neither None nor Invalid.
CP_020 ignores RequestFlag64 when its unique variation mode is active.
Supplied Damage exports contain 748 None rows, 225 CursedEnergyAttack_1 rows, 217 CursedEnergyAttack_2 rows and 11 ExtraAttack rows. No Invalid row appears.
